source_pdf_page 129-133 replaced by explicit source-local IMAGE_PAGES asset semantics; pixel review not claimed.
Ta corrected to non-invasive papillary carcinoma; Tis to CIS/flat high-grade lesion; T1 lamina propria/subepithelial connective tissue; Ta/T1/Tis remain NMIBC management group but Ta is not CIS.
Current terminology urothelial carcinoma/尿路上皮癌 added; 移行细胞癌 retained as historical 306 synonym only.
RCC CT/ selective biopsy, UTUC CTU+cytology -> conditional URS, bladder cystoscopy/TURBT diagnosis, and prostate PSA/DRE -> MRI/biopsy are now task-gated; old first/best labels remain Precision.

Old DRE/acid-phosphatase/bone-scan and localised-surgery/beyond-capsule-ADT table retained as exam Precision; Current treatment uses risk/stage/grade/life expectancy with surveillance, surgery, radiotherapy and systemic/ADT combinations.
Standard six-month medical therapy owns Current Core; historical 6-9 month failure and pre/post-operative duration values remain Precision; surgery individualized by damage, obstruction and function.

RUG retained as standard early male test and no-blind-repeated-instrumentation safety rule; flexible cystoscopy alternative, RUG complete/partial uncertainty and high/floating-prostate Precision boundaries added.
Cystography added; uncomplicated blunt extraperitoneal rupture corrected to continuous bladder drainage, complex extraperitoneal cases to surgery, blunt intraperitoneal rupture to repair.

Haemodynamic stability now top gate; stable suspected renal trauma -> multiphasic CT and predominantly nonoperative/embolisation pathways; persistent instability from renal bleeding -> exploration; haematuria-severity dissociation preserved.
